'''Yarrum''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] located in the [[Bri'ahl sector]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> During the [[High Republic Era]], the planet was a base for various [[pirate]] gangs.<ref name="The Jellyfruit Pursuit" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Yarrum debut simultaneously in "[[Yoda's Mission]]"<ref name="Yoda's Mission" /> and "[[The Jellyfruit Pursuit]],"<ref name="The Jellyfruit Pursuit" /> the second part of the [[The Young Jedi / Yoda's Mission|first episode]]<ref name="Yoda's Mission" /> and the first part of the [[The Jellyfruit Pursuit / Creature Safari|fifth episode]] of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the [[Disney Junior]] and [[Disney+]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]'' respectively,<ref name="The Jellyfruit Pursuit" /> which aired on [[May 4]], [[2023]].<ref name="D23 May">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-may-2023|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in May 2023}}</ref> However, "The Jellyfruit Pursuit" first identified the planet as Yarrum.<ref name="The Jellyfruit Pursuit" />
